Definition: properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint
BiblicalUsage: Musar is discipline, instruction, correction. The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction; despise not the chastening of the LORD, for whom the LORD loveth He correcteth; he that spareth his rod hateth his son; and happy is the man whom God correcteth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that discipline is love with its sleeves rolled up. God corrects the ones He loves, and the correction is the proof of the love, not the absence of it.
RelatedTopics: Wisdom; Obedience; Fear of the Lord
